neighbours.label: content words in practical how-to / advice prose (where to put something, when to start, what to wear), not narrative
fire: Before you plant, decide which corner of the yard will be the vegetable bed.
Guests should arrive early and leave their coats in the hallway.
If you plan to retire early, think about when to begin drawing your savings.
For best results, keep the cuttings in a bright spot away from direct sun.
Hikers are advised to carry extra water as part of their emergency kit.
Swimmers must tie long hair back under a cap before entering the pool.
When choosing a desk, leave enough room for a second monitor.
To save space, mount the shelves along the wall above the washer.
quiet: Last spring the old vegetable bed in the corner of the yard flooded twice.
The guests arrived late and their coats piled up in the hallway.
My grandfather retired early in 1987 and moved to the coast.
The cuttings grew quickly that summer and soon filled the window.
The hikers ran out of water on the second day of the trip.
She won the regional swimming final by half a second.
The desk was delivered on Tuesday with a scratch on one leg.
The shelves above the washer collapsed during the night.

notes: Card FLAG broad (1.2%); top examples are instructional: 'as part of a disaster-recovery plan', 'outdoor entertainment areas', 'want to start receiving', 'hair in a ponytail', 'locate this garden'.
